_views.text: Ritual_Sound_System listens for RITUEL_INVOKED messages on the bus. When a ritual keyword is received, it plays the corresponding sonic signature — a frequency sweep with a specific start, end, duration, and wave shape. RÉVEIL climbs from 432 to 639 Hz in 1.2 seconds. RÉPARATION glides from 417 to 528 Hz over 2.5 seconds — the listener hears the system healing in real time. AURORE sweeps the full Solfège spectrum from 396 to 963 Hz in 3 seconds. Each sound is self-explanatory — a non-visual user invoking CHAOS hears the harmonic explosion. They do not need the confirmation text.
